description: Python package that regenerates, with one command (python -m poreconn.run --stages analysis), every number, table and figure of the article "Pore connectivity and image-based permeability at routine micro-CT resolution: glass-bead packs, reef limestones, coquinas and trachytes" (Transport in Porous Media, submitted) from 64 micro-CT volumes of interest of glass-bead packs, reef limestones, coquinas and trachytes. Partial-volume (ISO-50) segmentation with bounds, connectivity and percolation, edge-corrected Euler characteristic density, Crofton surface density and critical diameter, imaging diagnostics (edge-spread function, median-filter sensitivity, enclosed-air control), resolution coarsening, sub-volume statistics and leave-one-specimen-out percolation prediction with within-specimen statistics, formation factor (finite volumes), permeability by a two-relaxation-time D3Q19 lattice Boltzmann solver and by SNOW-2 pore networks with mirror completion of the pores cut by the window faces, Kozeny-Carman and Katz-Thompson estimates, and the wall effect of packed columns. Tested with pytest against analytical solutions. The volumes of interest and derived data are archived in the companion data record.
